items.title_en: BCI With Virtual Reality for Stroke Rehabilitation: A Crossover Study
bullets_zh: ClinicalTrials.gov研究NCT07374276评估运动想象BCI结合虚拟现实用于卒中后手臂和手功能恢复。
该交叉设计比较MI-VR-BCI训练与标准康复，检验加入BCI是否改善功能结局。
其意义在于对非侵入式运动想象BCI在卒中后神经康复中的临床评估。
bullets_en: ClinicalTrials.gov study NCT07374276 evaluates motor imagery BCI combined with virtual reality for arm and hand recovery after stroke.
The crossover design compares MI-VR-BCI training against standard rehabilitation to test whether adding BCI improves functional outcomes.
It matters as a non-invasive clinical evaluation of motor imagery BCI in post-stroke neurorehabilitation.
items.brief: 卒中后运动想象BCI结合VR的临床试验，评估上肢康复效果。
items.brief_en: Clinical trial evaluating motor imagery BCI with VR for upper-limb recovery after stroke.
items.raw_excerpt: The goal of this clinical trial is to investigate if training sessions of motor imagery associated with brain-computer interface and motor observation through virtual reality (MI-VR-BCI) can help to improve arm and hand recovery after a stroke. The main questions to answer are: * Can adding MI-BCI-VR sessions improve upper limb movement? * Can it help stroke survivors perform daily activities more
